thread:
Maya: Quick postmortem follow-up from the Zenith dedicated outage earlier this week. I captured remediation items we need to track: VPC peering flaps, on-prem routing mismatch, and a tenant isolation bug that surfaced under burst. Want to assign owners and deadlines so we can close in this sprint.
Sam: I'll take ownership of the VPC peering automation (detect + auto-re-establish). I'll wire up alerting too. Ticket: TKT-4542. ETA: 2026-04-02.
Lee: I can own the on-prem routing mismatch, will coordinate with Zenith infra. Need a 2-hour window for config testing. Proposed ETA: 2026-04-05.
Rachel: I'll triage the isolation bug (memory leak in tenant bridge). Reproducer steps in TKT-4550, pushing a small fix today, will run canary on dedicated cluster.
Maya: Thanks. Can each of you drop a one-line acceptance criteria and blockers? Add to the postmortem doc and ping me.
Sam: Acceptance: automated peering recovery succeeds within 45s for 95% of simulated flaps. Blocker: need cross-account IAM role from Zenith infra team (I've asked, awaiting reply).
Lee: Acceptance: routes reconcile with BGP sessions up within 120s and no host-level NAT collisions. Blocker: need Zenith netops to approve maintenance window.
Rachel: Acceptance: no cross-tenant memory growth after 24h load test. Blocker: need access to Zenith load generator credentials.
Maya: I'll bootstrap the timeline and add owners to the action tracker. Schedule weekly check-ins until closed. Can we get quick wins: Sam deploy alert runbook; Rachel run canary; Lee request window?
Sam: Deploying alert runbook now — infra-bot will post status.
infra-bot: runbook deployment started: deploy/peering-runbook v1 -> staging
infra-bot: deploy succeeded in 2m14s :white_check_mark:
Rachel: Canary started against staging cluster, small traffic. Will report 2h.
Lee: Sent maintenance window request to Zenith netops, awaiting ACK.
Maya: Noted. For recurring incident patterns: we saw peering flaps + on-prem transient NAT overlap twice in the last 3 months (Feb, Mar). We should add a quarterly audit of BGP/peering configs for Dedicated customers.
Sam: Agreed — I'll own the audit checklist, drop it in the ops repo.
Maya: Ok added items: TKT-4542 (peering automation), TKT-4550 (isolation bug), TKT-4551 (BGP audit). I'll mark owners and target close dates in tracker. Next sync: Monday standup.
Lee: FYI I've stubbed config remediations in a branch:
```
# diff --config
+ iptables -t nat -A POSTROUTING -s 10.2.0.0/16 -o eth0 -j MASQUERADE
```
Rachel: Thanks — I'll validate with canary.
Maya: Thanks team. If any blocker persists past 48h escalate to oncall. :thumbsup:
